verdict.rationale: Luma's own llms.txt states that the Luma API ships Python/JS/TS SDKs, so official SDKs are a documented first-party capability. That is the only mention: no SDK reference, install or package details, or usage examples appear in the pack, and the piapi.ai API a commenter mentions is third-party and earns no credit. missing for 10: SDK reference documentation, package/install details and code samples, coverage of the current Agents API surface, independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Luma API: Two endpoints, Python/JS/TS SDKs, credit-based pricing, production-grade from day one
